basic_info.description: Just steps to GG Park & the many cafes, restaurants & boutiques on vibrant Irving Street, this sunny top-floor corner 2 bedroom 1 bathroom condo has it ALL!     Rebuilt w/the finest materials & converted to condo in 2022, this exquisite property is the perfect blend of San Francisco charm & high tech/design, for modern living at its finest.    The inviting entry welcomes you to the grand living room (w/cozy gas fireplace & built-in home theatre) that is flooded with light from multiple windows (w/remote-controlled shades).    The chef's kitchen boasts Viking stainless appliances, marble counters & backsplash, abundant custom cabinetry & large dining area opening to the rear balcony & stairs leading to the shared landscaped garden & covered patio that is perfect for relaxing, bbq-ing & entertaining.     2 spacious bedrooms w/seating/office nooks feature large closets w/frosted glass & black steel doors. A luxe bathroom w/marble surround & flooring & designer fixtures & 3 additional storage closets complete the layout.     Gorgeous solid white oak floors, solid pine trim, recessed lighting, dual-pane windows, Smart Google home system, Lutron switches, NEST thermostat, Wilkins surround system, on-site laundry, 2 pkg spaces, exclusive roof rights and much more!
